raw_segments.text: Queen, I wonder, Doctor, thou askst thee me such a question.
Have I not been thy pupil long?
Hast thou not learn me how to make perfumes?
Yea, so that our great King himself doth woo me oft for my confections.
Having thus far proceeded, unless thou thinkst thee me devilish, ist not meet that I did
amplify my judgment in other conclusions.
I will try the forces of these thy compounds on such creatures as we count not worth the
hanging, but none human to try the vigor of them and apply allayments to their act,
and by them gather their several virtues and effects.
